description: Kimchi premium on two bases: premium_official_pct (official USD/KRW rate — the quoted figure) and premium_usdt_pct (Upbit KRW/USDT rate — a gross spot-price comparison using KRW/USDT conversion, before spreads, fees, liquidity and transfer constraints). The two frequently disagree in sign. Optional ?symbols=BTC,ETH (max 10). Costs $0.03 in USDC per call, settled via x402.

symbols.description: Comma-separated coin tickers, e.g. BTC,ETH,XRP. Default: BTC,ETH,XRP,SOL,DOGE
